summary: Adopt a guarantee-first cache decision flow with a protocol table carrying an explicit evidence-status column: name the contract, establish writer-observation completeness, identify source capabilities, then choose topology and publication protocol, with performance controls separate. Teach the studied mechanisms, keep every number on an active claim, and route the newer Study 05 results through a versioned evidence update.
disagreements: Preserved: how much unmeasured deletion/outbox protocol design belongs in the book; whether cache-side fences are uniquely necessary (resolved as fence-or-equivalent, recorded); which unmeasured tactics warrant controlled pairs.
